name: What are the common pitfalls to avoid when planning energy-efficient home renovations?

mainEntity.name: What are the common pitfalls to avoid when planning energy-efficient home renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: A common pitfall in energy-efficient renovations is approaching upgrades piecemeal without a cohesive plan, which can lead to inefficiencies or missed opportunities. Another is overlooking the importance of a properly sealed building envelope; even the most efficient windows or HVAC systems won't perform optimally if air leaks are present. AKN Design Group's integrated design-build approach mitigates these risks by planning all upgrades in coordination, ensuring that elements like insulation, windows, and HVAC are installed and integrated for maximum overall performance and value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid piecemeal upgrades and neglecting the building envelope. Our integrated design-build process ensures all energy-efficient elements are coordinated for optimal performance.
